subject: Postmortem: empty-chair trial onboarding — propose rebook + async debug
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Priyanka Sharma <priyanka@fintegral.com>, Fintegral Engineering Team <eng@fintegral.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-05T15:00:00-07:00
Subject: Trial onboarding office hours — API + SDK (today 3:00pm PT)

Hi Priyanka —

Quick reminder: our 30-minute integration office hours are scheduled for today at 3:00pm PT. We'll walk through API key handoff, SDK install, and a quick inference sanity check. Join link: https://meet.redwood.ai/rooms/fintegral-onboard.

Agenda (30 mins):
- 5m: intros + goals
- 10m: API key handoff and SDK install (node + python snippets)
- 10m: run a demo inference and troubleshoot common errors (401 / CORS / egress)
- 5m: next steps / follow-ups

I've attached a short preflight checklist and a tiny sandbox token if you want to test ahead of time. If the time is inconvenient, reply with 2-3 alternate slots and we'll rebook.

Attachments: redwood_preflight_checklist.pdf

Thanks —
Jordan
Principal Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
[jordan_blake@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0124]

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Priyanka Sharma <priyanka@fintegral.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-05T15:36:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Trial onboarding office hours — API + SDK (today 3:00pm PT)

Hi all —

We were in the room at 3:00 and didn't see any Fintegral attendees. I left the meeting up for 15 minutes in case there was a delay. No worries — these things happen.

Two quick notes from our side that will speed up the next session if you reschedule:
- If you see 401s during SDK/CLI calls, confirm the API key hasn't been rotated in your secrets manager. A common failure is using an old key with the same label.
- If the SDK process fails on the first inference, check outbound egress to our endpoint (api.redwood.ai) and DNS resolution — many corp networks block unknown hosts by default.

I've attached the preflight checklist again and a temporary sandbox key you can try in a restricted environment. If you'd like, we can also do an async troubleshooting pass — paste the error log into a support ticket and we'll triage.

Propose rebook slots (PT):
- Thu 5/6 9:30am–10:00am
- Thu 5/6 10:30am–11:00am
- Fri 5/7 1:00pm–1:30pm

If none of those work, send 2 slots that suit your engineering team and we'll prioritize.

Attachments: redwood_preflight_checklist.pdf, sandbox-temp-key.txt

Best,
Jordan

From: Priyanka Sharma <priyanka@fintegral.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Fintegral Engineering Team <eng@fintegral.com>
Date: 2027-05-06T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Trial onboarding office hours — API + SDK (today 3:00pm PT)

Hi Jordan —

Really sorry about the no-show. We had an internal change that caused the engineering lead to be pulled into an outage and the calendar link didn't update. My fault for not notifying you earlier.

We tried to run the SDK setup this morning and hit a 401 when calling POST /v1/infer. I pasted the error snippet below (sanitized):

---- begin log ----
{"status":401, "error":"Unauthorized", "message":"Invalid API key: key_OLD_123"}
---- end log ----

We think our CI rotated keys overnight and the env var used by the local dev host didn't pick up the new secret. We can rotate back but would prefer to get a fresh temp key to avoid exposing permanent credentials. Also, our security team blocks unknown egress hosts by default — they asked us to provide the final FQDNs and IP ranges for approval.

Available slots: Thu 5/6 10:30am–11:00am (works for our lead) or Fri 5/7 1:00pm–1:30pm. If you can do 10:30 today that would be ideal.

I've attached the debug log (sanitized) in case it helps.

Apologies again — we'll be on for the 10:30 slot if you can confirm.

Thanks,
Priyanka
Senior Engineering Manager, Fintegral
[priyanka@fintegral.com | +1 212-555-0199]

Attachments: client-debug-log-20270505.txt

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Priyanka Sharma <priyanka@fintegral.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-06T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Trial onboarding office hours — API + SDK (today 3:00pm PT)

Hi Priyanka — thanks for the quick reply and the log. No problem on the outage — we appreciate the heads up.

Confirmed: 10:30am–11:00am PT today works for us. I'll join for the SDK/telemetry portion. Jordan will handle API key handoff. Marissa will be on to help with firewall/egress troubleshooting if needed.

Before the call, two things that speed triage:
- Temp sandbox key: attached (sandbox-temp-key.txt). Use this in a local environment (not production) to confirm SDK happy path.
- Egress checklist: provide your security team these endpoints: api.redwood.ai (443), telemetry.redwood.ai (443). We've added the Drive link with IP ranges and a one-pager to the related links field.

If you hit the 401 again, try: 1) confirm ENV var REDWOOD_API_KEY matches the key in the sandbox-temp-key.txt; 2) curl -v to https://api.redwood.ai/v1/health to verify TLS/DNS; 3) paste the verbose curl output into a ticket and we'll triage async.

Attachments: sandbox-temp-key.txt

See you at 10:30.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
[ben_carter@redwood.ai]
